decision_rule: Admit the M105 action-anchor outcome recipe only if normal behavior retention, ablation-induced degradation, and positive hidden-envelope lift survive repeat checkpoints and stronger history interventions.
failure_criteria: any repeat checkpoint loses M62-level normal behavior retention
reset-hidden or zero-response degradation disappears on repeats
braking or lateral response-hidden-minus-reset lift turns negative on repeats
stronger delayed-history or wrong-history interventions do not affect behavior when available
the repeat requires changing deployable actor inputs or adding oracle labels
hypothesis: M105 is promising but under-tested: if the action-anchor outcome recipe really binds recurrent response history to behavior, the effect should survive repeat checkpoints and stronger history interventions.
success_criteria: normal M62-level success and margin retention pass on 9711 and 9712
reset-hidden and zero-response ablations degrade behavior on repeats
braking and lateral hidden-envelope lift stay positive on repeats
delayed-history or wrong-history interventions are reported when available
the decision is recorded before PPO continuation
